# opwan_addresses (Data Source)

Every address of the account, lowest first, with where each is routed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opwan_addresses" "all" {}

output "unassigned" {
  value = [for a in data.opwan_addresses.all.addresses : a.ip if a.assignment == "unassigned"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `addresses` (Attributes List) The addresses, lowest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--addresses))
- `entitlement` (Number) How many addresses the account pays for (one per tunnel plus the extra addresses).

<a id="nestedatt--addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `addresses`

Read-Only:

- `assigned_at` (String) When the account got it (RFC 3339).
- `assignment` (String) Where it goes: `tunnel`, `bgp` or `unassigned`.
- `block` (String) The block it was bought in (`72.244.89.16/30`), null for a single address.
- `ip` (String) The address (dotted IPv4).
- `location` (String) The address's location id.
- `tunnel_id` (String) The tunnel it's routed down, or for `bgp` the one announcing it now. Null when none.
